motion.name: hero-figure-entrance

motion.name: Scroll-driven animation
motion.value: scrub: true; ease: none; start: top 45%; end: bottom 75%
motion.purpose: Three illustrative service concepts follow native scroll. Enabled at minimum 800px width and 650px height with no reduced motion; CSS sticky stage, no wheel interception. Setup and ScrollTrigger refreshInit uniformly fit the visual plane after subtracting sticky top, the unscaled caption plus margin, computed blur height, and 16px clearance. The frame reserves scaled height; no measurement runs on scroll frames. Natural height is clamp(25rem, 41vw, 37rem), overridden to 35rem at 800–1100px. Cleanup removes the refresh listener and inline height/transform.

motion.name: service-concept-pose
motion.purpose: Resting dimensional pose for the first two concepts; the final web concept settles flat. Transform and opacity are reversible through scroll.

motion.name: Parallax — footer-wordmark
motion.value: 180ms; rotateX/rotateY up to ±3.5deg; translateX up to ±5px
motion.purpose: Interruptible CSS response to direct child transform writes, coalesced with requestAnimationFrame; mouse, fine pointer, hover, and no-preference only.

motion.name: Parallax — footer-light
motion.value: 240ms; translateX up to ±60%; translateY up to ±25%
motion.purpose: The companion light moves without repainting a changing gradient. Pointer leave, focus, scroll, resize, preference changes, and unmount reset/clean up the effect.

narrative.overview:
Zavino presents technology through the physical calm of an industrial design catalogue: cool daylight, matte objects, generous image fields, clear type, and open rows. The visual system makes the work approachable while retaining enough structure for service detail, product concepts, and inquiry forms.

Preserve the Zavino name and symbol. The implemented world replaces the former dark systems dashboard with mist surfaces and blue ink. Imagery carries material character; navigation and controls stay quiet. The user-approved motion expansion adds a coordinated hero Reveal and Stagger, a native-scroll service showcase, a dimensional footer with pointer Parallax, and a bounded progressive Blur/Mask. Press / Tap feedback and Origin-aware menu animation remain in place.
keyCharacteristics: Medium-weight Manrope headings pair with platform body text.
Broad imagery, ruled service chapters, and a bounded visual stage give content room to breathe.
Controls use small radii, clear boundaries, and visible focus.
Work and demonstrations retain explicit, truthful attribution.
Motion is tied to entrance, scroll progress, or direct input; compact and preference-based alternatives remain available.

rules.name: The Section Ground Rule
rules.body: Use the pale grounds to organize content groups; use blue ink for reading and actions.

rules.name: The Readable Entry Rule
rules.body: Editable text stays at the field size, and labels remain visible above the control.

rules.name: The Object Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve dimensional depth for physical imagery, floating dialogs, illustrative interface objects, and the footer signature; keep ordinary reading surfaces flat.

dos: Do use pale grounds for section grouping and blue ink for reading and actions.
Do pair medium Manrope headings with readable platform body text.
Do preserve broad image fields, ruled service chapters, and the hierarchy between primary and supporting content.
Do preserve visible focus, explicit field labels, immediate keyboard responses, and preference-based alternatives.
Do distinguish owned products, delivered creative work, and illustrative concepts in nearby copy.
Do retain provenance when replacing or adding a shipping raster.
donts: Don't restore the former dark dashboard aesthetic or add technical decoration to imply sophistication.
Don't add decorative kickers or use nonsequential numbers as a house style.
Don't turn every service or content group into a raised card.
Don't intercept native scrolling or add continuous idle animation; the brand image remains a still.
Don't reduce editable text below the field token or animate keyboard focus.
Don't present concepts, simulated states, or brand imagery as delivered customer outcomes.
